authorization.scope: Coordinated package publication and matching Server upgrade; the publication request separately authorizes only the candidate-bound manual staging waiver under ADR-0048. No unrelated data or schema changes.

webDeployment.scope: Independent actual deploy-job, SSM, public Web commit and healthy running-container identity acceptance; Server observation is explicitly before its separately authorized upgrade.

sourceBinding.proofScope: Locally verified git diff and identical tree IDs; the frozen candidate differs from the merge only by its candidate-bound waiver.

local.source: Final completed local verification reported by root; check/release log contents and their hashes read independently by the evidence helper. These are local gate results, not public publication or rollout acceptance.

check.scope: Repository/docs/architecture, workspace typechecks/tests, browser scenarios, real Codex/Go E2E and Go unit suites. The two existing CLI skips are disclosed; the required installed historical clock gate is separately mandatory and ran.

evidence.retainedRuntimeRollbackAfterNewCursor: unsupported; recover forward with target runtime
evidence.providerCaptureTested: constructed native-format source through genuine installed readers
evidence.server: owned HTTP Test Adapter for Canonical v2/v3/v4 and Raw; Publication unavailable; no deployed Instance touched

release.scope: The final ordinary complete command passed; exact local checksummed archives and the genuine npm-published 0.5.9 parent transition were tested. Public npm/GitHub/CDN byte acceptance is separately recorded below.

previousWebRuns.scope: Earlier overall workflow success with skipped actual deploy job; retained as history and not attributed to the later successful Web deployment.

candidateVerificationHistory.boundary: The failing fixture used expect.poll's default 1-second timeout. This is separate from the existing production native process probe's 2-second bound.
candidateVerificationHistory.recovery: Focused 2/2 rerun passed, followed by a fresh completed full check with 1062 CLI tests and 91 browser scenarios passed.

candidateVerificationHistory.boundary: Existing 2-second native process ownership/startup probe failed closed.

candidateVerificationHistory.exactResourceCause: not established; this wrapper error is not described as a Server deployment failure

scan.scope: Independent readback binds the reviewed archive, config, current HIGH/CRITICAL scan and running Server to the same immutable image.

effectivePinReadbackProof.scope: Selected Server/init/environment image pins and targeted running-image identity; complete environment values were not read back into evidence.

imageOnlyReadCompatibility.scope: The retained v0.5.9 image is a compatible v3/v4/storage recovery target by the existing contracts and unchanged migration boundary. No old-image Reader replay or production rollback/restore was executed for this rollout.

recovery.boundary: The intended compatible retained Server is v0.5.9, which already supports nullable Canonical v3/v4. This release adds no schema or Canonical storage migration. Pre-v4 images retain their older incompatible Reader boundary. An image compatibility check does not establish a production rollback or restore.
recovery.baselineImageSource: Independent pre-Server-upgrade observation preserved under webObservations.
recovery.scope: Read-only actual retained rollback tag/image and saved non-secret image-pin comparison; no rollback acceptance or restore

operatorReview.source: Root-confirmed independent review of the final frozen operator artifact; no deployment execution is claimed.

preparation.scope: Read-only independently rechecked current archive/report/config/labels/source facts; no deployment, container launch, backup or snapshot performed

deployment.scope: Only selected safe SSM result metadata; no CommandId, InstanceId, raw stdout/stderr or private resource metadata.

independentLiveVerification.scope: Independent selected read-only live inspection; synthetic HTTP smoke result read back, not rerun

backup.verification: Fresh paired archive hashes, PostgreSQL archive listing, gzip integrity and root-filesystem placement independently checked; no production restore performed.

snapshot.sanitizedReceiptDigestEncoding: UTF-8 JSON, lexicographically sorted keys, compact separators, no final newline
snapshot.scope: Root controller confirmed actual encrypted root-volume snapshot completion at 100% and the stopped-writer/pair claim. Independent selected readback subsequently verified completion and binding. Private snapshot/volume/claim/device identifiers and raw private receipt hashes are omitted. No restore occurred.

serverBoundaryBeforeUpgrade.scope: Observed before the separately authorized .10 Server upgrade; no claim about later Server state

webObservations.scope: Independent read-only GH, corresponding existing deploy SSM invocation, targeted Docker metadata SSM, and public edge readback. No deployment/restart/workflow rerun/application or DB mutation. No private AWS resource IDs, environment values, secrets, fixture IDs or source payloads in evidence.
Independent selected post-Server-rollout readback; previously independently deployed Web image/revision/start remained unchanged.

rangeEvidence.readerStaleProofScope: Root reviewed the frozen live-smoke.go stale-range-cursor-reader assertion: the conditional Reader with the old snapshot must return 409 before SnapshotReplacementRejected becomes true. The actual deploy smoke recorded that true; independent readback read its result and did not rerun HTTP.

loopbackSmoke.clockPrecisionScope: The rollout helper uses whole-second fixture clocks. It does not verify preservation of subsecond formatting or precision in Reader responses.
loopbackSmoke.scope: Actual authenticated synthetic loopback HTTP/API smoke during Server deployment, with 7 v4 records, 1 direct legacy v2 record, scoped/global statistics, 60 bins, range pages and conditional Reader/stale checks. Independent readback verified recorded success and cleanup, without rerunning HTTP. No fresh native Provider recording or real GitHub OAuth.

cleanup.retainedMetadata: Synthetic identity/User, Team and audit metadata remain. Only owned synthetic Session/Project deletion and CLI/Web revocation Interfaces were used; no SQL teardown.

provenance.scope: Exact public tarball bytes and decoded provenance statement content; no signature, certificate-chain or transparency-proof verification.

publishedInstallSmoke.scope: Anonymous public manifest/archive and byte acceptance; no additional installation or Provider execution from the public registry.

acceptancePlan.distributionScope: Compare each exact public npm manifest/archive and all nine GitHub Release assets with the independently retained local and successful Release-workflow bytes. Compare both CDN catalogs, immutable v0.5.10 descriptors and every historical descriptor against a separately retained pre-publication baseline.

remainingLimits: All ten manual staging checks remain pending under the unchanged candidate-bound manual-only waiver; automated delivery evidence does not complete them.

No production restore, production rollback, explicit schema migration command or old-image Reader replay was performed.
The synthetic rollout helper uses whole-second clocks and does not establish subsecond Reader formatting or precision.
Decoded provenance content is not cryptographic signature verification.
No additional public registry installation/execution smoke was performed; local installed exact-byte release gates and anonymous public-byte acceptance are separate checks.
Unavailable old source history remains unrepaired; legacy dated clocks remain outside recorded activity until eligible source replay.
sanitization: No credentials, personal transcript/tool bodies, private account/resource identifiers or raw operator logs. Keep only sanitized receipt hashes and non-secret identity/outcome fields.
